name: ak:ship
overview: Ship pipeline: merge main, test, review, commit, push, PR. Single command from feature branch to PR URL. Use for shipping official releases to main/master or beta releases to dev/beta branches.
whenToUse: Invoke when a completed branch needs PR shipping workflow.

flags.name: --skip-tests
flags.desc: Skip test step (use when tests already passed)

flags.name: --dry-run
flags.desc: Show what would happen without executing

subcommands.name: official
subcommands.desc: Ship to default branch (main/master). Full pipeline with docs + journal

subcommands.name: beta
subcommands.desc: Ship to dev/beta branch. Lighter pipeline, skip docs update
